title: Title: ⚔️ It's Time to Shake EVE Online: Let’s Start a War Worth Over $5,000 in Losses ⚔️

posts.cooked:
Fellow capsuleers,

EVE Online used to be a living, breathing universe — full of chaos, betrayal, and wars that echoed through gaming history. But lately… it feels too quiet. Too stable. Too peaceful.

It’s time to change that.

I believe we — especially us Alpha pilots — can make history again. Let’s ignite a conflict so massive that it shakes New Eden to its core, a war where total losses surpass $5,000 USD worth of ships and assets. Not for griefing, not for trolling — but to revive the spirit of true EVE: strategy, courage, and destruction.

Let’s bring together a coalition of pilots who share one goal:
⚔️ To make EVE feel alive again.

I’m looking for fellow thinkers and risk-takers — Alpha and Omega alike — who are ready to plan, coordinate, and execute something unforgettable.

If you believe EVE needs fire again — reply here, share your ideas, and let’s start designing the war that will make the headlines again.

Fly dangerous,

so, $5000 ISD = over 500 bil ISK, please correct me if I'm wrong (or rather, if chatgpt is wrong, it's too late @ night for me to do any math)

I absolutely support your idea, and if you manage to get a lot of players to fly with you and attack people, it would be great. However I am a bit confused...

See, I am currently involved in a null war between two smaller entities, with regular losses over tens bil ISK per battle, typically 3-4 of such battles per week. The war goes on for months at this point, so I'm fairly sure the price of it is way above $5000 USD, as it is common in wars.

And that is just a war between two smaller entities.

There is also a war between Imperium and Horde, going on practically since last June or so, but most people would say it flared up during last few months, where Goons managed to conquer Horde's floodplains and are dangerously close to core Horde regions. I know both entities tend to fly cheaper ships, but they are also magnitude larger than us and I'm sure they field multiple fleets per day, so there must be some losses on their side as well, as seen on this battlereport.

There might be also a potential war between INIT and Fraternity - there were hints this is going to happen, and the last impediment (PC) has been removed from Pure Blind, so maybe something is brewing on their side, too.

And that's just nullsec. I'm fairly sure there are wars in wormholes, there are clashes in lowsec (BIGAB, SEDIT, FL33T, SC, and so on).

It just requires you (= everyone who reads this) to step out of highsec, where nothing noteworthy ever happens, and go to live with new friends in some fun area.

There's nothing fundamentally wrong with the OP's idea. The only problem lies in execution, because the vast majority of the people in the availability pool for something like this play the game solely for the sake of grinding PvE.

It might be possible to create some sort of rookie swarm if it's fully funded, but to make that sustainable for any moderate period of time you'd need something in the ballpark of 1-5 trillion ISK. To put it in perspective, a trillion can buy 200,000 fitted frigates, and a swarm would be burning through ships very quickly, with a single player taking dozens of losses every week. Of course it's not just ships that cost money, but consumables, logistics, etc.
